name: Mizuno Megumi
source: A genius scientist who uses a technique developed by their late father to turn [url=/c78752]Ryou[/url] into a girl. She uses various, often sexual techniques to try and turn Ryou back into a boy but her true intention seems to be to use her DNA to impregnate her "sister".
